parameters.query: SELECT o.slug AS organization_slug FROM organization_whatsapp_providers p JOIN organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id WHERE p.provider='waha' AND p.session_name=$1 AND p.enabled=true ORDER BY p.priority ASC LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode: const route=$json;const src=$node['Prepare WAHA Message'].json;if(!route.organization_slug)throw new Error('no organization mapped to WAHA session');const p=src.payload;const b=src.body;const remote=src.remote;const messageId=src.message_id;const media=p.media??null;let type='text';if(p.hasMedia===true&&media){const mime=String(media.mimetype||'');if(mime.startsWith('audio/'))type='audio';else if(mime.startsWith('image/'))type='image';else if(mime.startsWith('video/'))type='video';else type='file';}return [{json:{provider_token:src.provider_token,payload:{organization_slug:String(route.organization_slug),channel:'whatsapp',contact:{external_id:remote,name:p._data?.notifyName??p._data?.pushname??null,phone:remote},conversation_id:remote,message_id:messageId,external_message_id:messageId,message_type:type,text:String(p.body??''),timestamp:p.timestamp??null,provider:'waha',provider_session:src.session,media,raw:b}}}];
